event_name: Date 01 July 2018 Time 12:53 2018 AUSTRIAN GRAND PRIX 28 June - 01 July 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 36), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: A 5th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE), 5th Turbo Charger (TC), 5th Motor Generator Unit Heat (MGU-H) and 4th Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K have been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Articles 23.3 a) and 23.3 b). The team notified the Technical Delegate regarding the change of the power unit elements on the 30th June, at 19:24. All
